# M0-b-04 — the check's minor notes (for the hardening pass; none of them fails the item)

These notes come from the first independent check of M0-b-04, made as the closing check of the session's completion
round (lane `check/M0-b-04-close-s1`, flow flow-7, stage group S, 2026-10-06). The verdict and its one failing line
are in `checks/M0-b-04-s1.md`. Each row below is minor under N-45 (J202) and N-48 (J214). It fails safely, it is
reported, or it is a test gap on code that the checker's own probe confirmed correct. Each row is tagged `KI` and
names its handling and its milestone. "Survivor" means a targeted mutant of this check that left all 35 tests of
`bench/test/bentcut/` green. That folder is the near set, and it is also the related set of `bench/src/bentcut/`.

| id | observation | suggested handling | milestone |
|---|---|---|---|
| N-1 | **KI. F-CUT's depth-0 ladders end `unresolved` on 59 of 10⁵ faces.** The bar run reports `outcomes {"cut":72877,"slit":4457,"block":21241,"court":1366,"unresolved":59}`. The checker's probe A scanned F-CUT tasks 0 – 5 999 at seed 1 and found 9 such faces, all `concave` (for example j 212, concave #106). On each one, rung (a) planned nothing (`failed`) in all three frames, and the pre-cut, rung (b) and every rung-(c) slide were refused (`kerb-arrival`, `width`, once `contact`). The face is above the substitution bound, so it stands whole as an `unresolved` block with 0 kernel calls (on #106, minor 117.8 m against τ 45.9 m). The F-CUT bar as written holds: the ladder ends in ≤ 6 calls and no face count decreases. The outcome is counted in the summary, but the verdict line does not name it, and §4.6 step 8 calls rung (c) "always-succeeding". | M0-b-04: print the unresolved count beside the F-CUT verdict, and record in a choices row that an `unresolved` ladder ends the ladder (it is not a pass of rung (c)). S8 side: the same class as `checks/M0-b-03-notes.md` N-3; M0-x-05 / M0-b-03 harden rung (c) on concave faces. | M4 (reporting); M0-b-03 / M0-x-05 hardening |
| N-2 | **KI. The arrival clause's 100 % is close to true by construction.** `arrivalCdeg` measures the arriving leg against the far run's direction, as the planner chose it. Step 5 builds the second leg square to that same direction, so only snapping can move the angle (C-0242 (6) declares this reading). The checker measured arrivals independently from the committed geometry (probe C, 40 faces per M0 (b) kind at seed 1, both ends of every lane against the crossed chain's raw edge at the end vertex). Planner cuts reach ≥ 85° on 3 681 / 3 740 ends (98.4 %; every kind ≥ 97.8 %), or 3 569 / 3 740 (95.4 %) on ±5 m chords. All lanes, the ladder's straight fallbacks included, reach 4 033 / 4 212 (95.75 %): `holed` 684 / 736 (92.9 %) and `C-shaped` 1 137 / 1 200 (94.75 %). The clause holds on the committed geometry as judged (pooled, planner cuts). The summary's `arrival85Chord` (99.3 %) is the only number in it that is not measured against the planner's own direction. | Report a committed-geometry arrival beside the judged one, for planner cuts and for all lanes, so that M0-b-05b's comparison on NG's shapes reads like with like. | M0-b-05b / M4 |
| N-3 | **KI. The corner and arrival clauses do not gate on replay misses.** `foldSignature` judges the shares over the cuts that were matched. A rising miss count would quietly shrink the population; the misses are reported, but they do not fail a clause. The bar run had 0 misses in 4 798. In the same way, `corner.n` counts every bent cut, while the share counts only the bent cuts that carry a `cornerT` (here the two are equal). | Fail a clause, or flag it, when `missed > 0` or a bent cut lacks `cornerT`. | M4 |
| N-4 | **KI. Test gaps on code the checker's probes confirmed correct (N-48).** Survivors: **K15** (F-CUT folded without the residue's every-depth records), **K16** (the exit code reads only F-CUT's verdict), **K13 / K27** (the corner / arrival pass without `refused === 0`), **K30** (every-depth ladder decreases not counted in `fullOf`), **K12** (rungs (b) and (c) replayed as planner cuts), **K21** (the `overLimit` fallback to S8's own run dropped), **K09** (`faceKind` inverted; σ plain / ring are only reported). Confirmations: probe 2 drove `run()` with planted records. A 7-call ladder at depth > 0, a corner off mid-course, an arrival of 80°, g = 0.5 and a residue district that threw each gave exit 1, with the right verdict false. The control gave exit 0. The bar run's report has `replay {planner 4798, fallback 177, deep 378, missed 0, notReplayed 0}` and `ring` 0 for every hole-free kind (219 for `holed`). K21's path is unreached at the bar's sizes (`notReplayed 0`). | Add the planted-record cases through `run()` (as probe 2 did), a fixture that contains a rung-(b)/(c) lane in the replay test, a refused district in the fold tests, and an `overLimit` replay. | M4 |
| N-5 | **KI. The replay's landing tolerance is not pinned (survivor K10, attractCm + 1 → attractCm + 100).** An instrumented copy over 20 faces per kind measured the accepted landings: 956, of which 787 were exactly 0, with p99 22.6 cm and max 26.0 cm (the bound is 27). A looser bound changes nothing on these inputs, because none misses, but it would hide a mismatch. | A `lands` test at the absolute value (a 28 cm offset refused). | M4 |
| N-6 | **Equivalent survivors.** K11 (the stop-uniform guard): the replay draws on the same streams, so the guard never fires (0 misses). K22 (the `no depth-0 ladder` guard): every one of the 10⁵ district reports had a depth-0 ladder. | None (one-line notes, J169). | — |
| N-7 | **KI. The `straightFirst` branch is never exercised by the harness.** `sampleOf`'s `arrivalCross2` path and the planner's `alternate` geometry are reached only under `cut.bendMode` `straightFirst` (the MFCG preset). The harness runs the shipped `flatten` table, so the replay always has a single candidate, and those two paths have no test here. | Run the signature once under the MFCG preset's cells when the parity presets land. | M1 (parity presets) / M0-b-05b |
| N-8 | **KI. The worker pool has no `exit` handler.** `pool.ts` rejects on a worker's `error` event, but a worker that exits without one (for example out of memory) leaves the promise pending, and the run hangs. `runTask` catches every throw, so this was not seen. | Handle `exit` with a non-zero code as a failure. | M4 |
